approval.scope: Adopt the reconciled release-evidence policy, grading, explicit shipping-exception mechanism and probe decision. This is not approval of any individual shipping exception or public release.

nativeProbe.budget: One day of bounded alternative/decomposition work; record actual elapsed work and attempt costs before reassessment.
nativeProbe.ifIncomplete: Report proven scope, unverified scope, measured continuation cost; keep general proof open pending Jay decision.

certoraVersionPolicy: Recover an exact run/tool version before newly grading Certora evidence; do not invent the missing version.
aggregation: The row grade is the weakest of its seven components, within each explicitly declared scope. It is not proof of a general runtime-to-model theorem.
nonclaims: No individual shipping exception is approved by this reset.
No deployment, public push, tag, release or paid execution is authorized.
Evidence metadata validation is not proof replay or semantic completeness.
